title: Lens Material Cancellation Refunds — Northgate Optical
content:
**Northgate Optical lens material cancellation refund.** In an in-lab cancellation, the lens material upgrade charge of the job is refunded as one refund credit against that charge, returned to the original tender.

The credit is posted against the job's material upgrade charge — the charge for a lens material other than standard plastic. Whatever part of the material charge is not refunded stays billed.

## Booking the refund: `refund_lens_material_ad7f47c2`

**Capability.** The tool refunds the lens material upgrade charge of an eyewear job as a cancellation refund. One call books one cancellation refund credit against the job's material upgrade charge, with the amount given, dated today, returned to the member's original tender; the rest of the material charge stays billed. The credit does not earn or take back Annual Reward.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `optical_order_id` | the reference number of the eyewear job that carries the material upgrade charge | identifier, read from the eyewear job lookup |
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member who owns the eyewear job | identifier, read from the customer profile lookup |
| `source_txn_id` | the reference number of the material upgrade charge being refunded | identifier, read from the job's charge and credit lookup |
| `material_refund_usd` | the amount of the material upgrade charge refunded, in USD | plain number, no currency sign, 2 decimal places, not below 0; rounded half-to-even to 2 decimal places on booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `optical_txn_id` (the reference number of the material refund credit), `optical_order_id` (the job), `source_txn_id` (the material upgrade charge refunded), `amount` (the refund, USD with 2 decimal places), `credit_reason` (always `cancellation_refund`) and `status` (`posted` when the refund is on the ledger).

## Reference notes

- The refund credit points back to the material upgrade charge and appears against it on the job's charge and credit lookup, with the cancellation refund reason.
